messages:
Maria: Heads-up — planning to start traffic-gating deploy for runtime v2.3 today at 16:30 PT. Proposed ramp: 2% -> 10% -> 40% -> 100%, 20m between steps. Need smoke owners, rollback ready, and confirmation on cohort selection.

Josh: I can own smoke for the first two waves (2% and 10%). Will monitor errors + p95. @Ana do you want to co-monitor logs? :eyes:

Ana: Yep, I can watch logs and traces. I'll keep an eye on model inference errors and token anomalies.

Priya: For cohorts I suggest limiting initial slices to non-enterprise customers and region us-west-2 only. Also exclude any customer with active experiments. That keeps blast radius small.

Liam: Agree with Priya. Implementation detail: we'll gate by user_bucket (mod 100). Plan mapping: buckets 0-1 => 2%, 2-11 => 10%, 12-51 => 40%, rest => 100%. Use feature flag runtime_v23 and rollout groups.

Maria: Good. Quick rollout config I'm going to pass to the deploy job:
```
rollout: runtime_v23
steps:
  - percent: 2
    buckets: [0,1]
    duration_min: 20
  - percent: 10
    buckets: [2..11]
    duration_min: 20
  - percent: 40
    buckets: [12..51]
    duration_min: 20
  - percent: 100
    buckets: [52..99]
    duration_min: 10
smoke_checks: [error_rate, p95_latency, token_cost_delta]
rollback_triggers:
  error_rate_threshold: 1.0  # percent
  p95_multiplier: 2.0
```

Josh: Quick question — what's baseline p95? Ana, do you have the 7d baseline numbers?

Ana: Baseline p95 (inference) is ~420ms in us-west-2. Error rate baseline ~0.05%.

Priya: Rollback decision criteria: if error_rate > 1% OR p95 > 2x baseline for two consecutive 5-min windows, rollback immediately. Josh/Ana will perform rollback. Maria to notify customers if rollback occurs.

Maria: Sounds good. I'll trigger the deploy at 16:30 and wait for Josh/Ana signoff after each step. Deploy job name: deploy/runtime/v2.3/traffic-gate. I will also attach the canary analysis dashboard link in the job.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy created by Maria: deploy/runtime/v2.3/traffic-gate — start=1948001400 (16:30 PT), owner=Maria, notify_on_step=true.

Liam: One more note — keep KV-cache warmers running for the first 5 minutes after each step to avoid cold-start p95 spikes. Add a 2-min pre-warm job before each step.

Maria: Adding pre-warm. Also toggling more verbose traces for the first 10m after each step (sampling 2%).

Josh: I'll post status after the 2% step. If green, proceed to 10%. If anything smells off, I'll abort and rollback.

Priya: I've recorded the cohort exclusion list (enterprises + active experiments) and shared it in the rollout doc.

Ana: I'll watch error budgets and traces. Alerting: paging rule if error_rate > 0.5% for 1min + p95 > 2x baseline.

Maria: Great. Final checklist: 1) Owners: Josh (smoke), Ana (logs/traces), Maria (deploy), Priya (cohorts) — confirmed. 2) Rollback criteria as above — confirmed. 3) Pre-warm & verbose traces — set. 4) Dashboard & job scheduled — done.

Josh: Ready on my side. :thumbsup:

Priya: Ready.

Liam: Standing by for pre-warm hooks.

Maria: OK launching at 16:30 PT. Will update here after first step.

Josh: 16:32 — 2% step complete, error_rate 0.03%, p95 430ms, token cost flat. Proceeding to 10%. :white_check_mark:

Ana: Logs look clean. No new error clusters.

Maria: Proceed to 10% now.

(remaining messages would be short step updates — omitted for brevity)
